title: Convert SAFEs at the priced round
summary: When the priced round closes, every outstanding SAFE converts to preferred stock: pull the notes and side letters, model the conversion math (caps, discounts, pro-rata rights), confirm the mechanics with counsel, execute the conversion on the cap-table platform, and tell the new stockholders what they own. The round documents themselves are signed in Close a priced equity round.

parts.title: Pull the outstanding SAFEs and side letters
parts.guidance: Collect all executed outstanding SAFEs, amendments and side letters, reconciling them to bank receipts and equity records. Identify the investor, amount, instrument version, conversion economics and special rights for each. Resolve missing signatures, inconsistent amendments and uncertain status with counsel so the conversion model starts from a complete set of controlling documents.

parts.title: Model the conversion (caps, discounts, pro-rata)
parts.guidance: Model each SAFE using its actual conversion definitions and the proposed round terms. Show capitalization inputs, price, cap or discount treatment and any separately exercised participation rights by holder. Test round-size or option-pool changes where they affect allocations, and reconcile totals and rounding. Keep legal interpretations and unresolved assumptions visible for counsel’s review.

parts.title: Counsel confirms the conversion mechanics
parts.guidance: Have counsel compare the conversion model with the executed instruments, side letters and financing documents. Resolve differences in instrument versions, capitalization definitions, conversion triggers, rights elections and required consents. Incorporate the agreed interpretation into both the model and closing documents so the allocations rest on the same terms.

parts.title: Review the pro-forma cap table with the lead investor
parts.guidance: Review the pro forma capitalization with the lead investor, showing existing holdings, conversion shares, new-money shares and the proposed option reserve. The founder shares the transaction-relevant table, with assumptions and closing conditions clearly labeled. Reconcile questions and corrections to counsel’s conversion model until the parties have a consistent allocation basis for closing.

parts.title: Execute the conversion and issue the preferred shares
parts.guidance: At closing, use the final conversion schedule and corporate authorizations to issue the specific preferred shares. Establish with counsel that executed documents, holder actions and closing conditions permit the conversion. The authorized equity administrator records the effective conversion and issuance, reconciling balances so a converted SAFE does not remain outstanding alongside its new shares.

parts.title: Notify SAFE holders with their share counts
parts.guidance: The company’s authorized equity contact sends each holder their completed conversion details: instrument, resulting share class and quantity, and access to final documents. Match notices to the closing schedule and keep each holder’s information separate. Resolve reported allocation discrepancies with counsel using the underlying calculation and controlling documents.

metadata.supportReason: Cap-table platforms pull the SAFEs, model the conversion, and issue the shares over their APIs; the side-letter judgment, the counsel check, and the lead-investor review of the pro-forma stay human.

contextNeeded.query: outstanding SAFE terms and side letters

geoNotes.summary: Convertibles here are CCDs/CCPS (or iSAFEs on CCPS): conversion is a fresh allotment — board resolution, PAS-3 to the MCA — and foreign-held instruments must be reported to the RBI (FC-GPR on the FIRMS portal) within 30 days.

ASAs convert at the round as a normal allotment (SH01 to Companies House) — and the conversion deadline is hard law for tax relief: S/EIS requires shares to be issued within the ASA's 6-month longstop.

Wandeldarlehen convert through a notarized capital increase: the loan claim is contributed, the resolution beurkundet, and the new shares exist on registration in the Handelsregister — the notary drives the closing timeline.
BSA-AIR holders exercise their warrants at the priced round: the resulting augmentation de capital is decided, the statuts updated, and the capital change filed through the guichet unique.

Convertible notes convert through the same mechanics as any raise: a shareholder-resolved capital increase contributing the loan claims, registered at the commercial registry — align the note terms with the registry timeline.

SAFEs and notes convert at the priced round as part of the private placement: the preferred shares issue under the same NI 45-106 exemptions and land in the post-closing report of exempt distribution.
